description: Project-owned metadata for binding Unreal visual assets to MWORKS planning/collision truth.

coordinate_system.default_axis_policy: MWORKS X/Z kept, MWORKS Y sign inverted in Unreal unless scene profile overrides

asset_fields.asset_id: stable unique id used by render profiles
asset_fields.semantic_type: uav | propeller | terrain | tree | building | wall | gate | ring | obstacle | marker | sensor

source.source_path: original local/reference path, never a token or private credential

unreal.scale_m: [x, y, z] visual scale in MWORKS meters before UE conversion

truth_binding.geometry_id: world_geometry primitive id, if this visual participates in collision/planning truth
truth_binding.collision_proxy_id: simplified proxy id used by planner/metrics
truth_binding.render_only: true only for visual helpers such as sky, decals, or UI markers

collision_proxy_fields.collision_proxy_id: stable id referenced by assets and scenarios
collision_proxy_fields.geometry_type: box | capsule | sphere | convex_hull | heightfield | occupancy_grid

rules: Every non-render-only obstacle, wall, gate, tree trunk, building, terrain, or ring must have a collision_proxy_id.
A visible obstacle without planning/collision truth is not allowed in formal evidence.
A planning/collision obstacle without a visible or explicitly hidden render asset must be documented.
RflySim assets remain pending_review until license and migration checks pass.
Do not put .pak, engine binaries, installer files, tokens, or external absolute secrets into the registry.
